---
title: "World Flags"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

# List all flag files in the data directory
flag_files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.png$")
flag_codes <- sub("\\.png$", "", flag_files)

# Custom mapping for non-standard ISO codes
custom_names <- c(
  "GB-ENG" = "England",
  "GB-NIR" = "Northern Ireland",
  "GB-SCT" = "Scotland",
  "GB-WLS" = "Wales",
  "XK"     = "Kosovo"
)

# Build tidy dataframe of countries, codes, and flag URLs
flags_df <- tibble(
  code = flag_codes,
  country = countrycode(
    toupper(code),
    origin = "iso2c",
    destination = "country.name",
    custom_match = custom_names
  ),
  url = paste0("https://flagcdn.com/w2560/", tolower(code), ".png")
) |>
  drop_na(country) |>
  arrange(country)

# Pass dataset to Observable JS
ojs_define(flags_data = flags_df)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selectedCountry = Inputs.select(
  flags_data.country,
  {
    label: "Select a country:",
    value: "United States"
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
selectedFlag = {
  const idx = flags_data.country.indexOf(selectedCountry);
  return {
    name: selectedCountry,
    code: flags_data.code[idx],
    url: flags_data.url[idx]
  };
}

html`
  <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
    <h3 style="margin-bottom: 0.75rem;">${selectedFlag.name}</h3>
    <img 
      src="${selectedFlag.url}" 
      alt="Flag of ${selectedFlag.name}" 
      style="max-width: 480px; width: 100%; height: auto; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); display: block;"
    />
  </div>
`
```
